draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Lighthouse Beach! It's the largest and southernmost of Kovalam's three crescent beaches, watched over by a 35 m lighthouse on Kurumkal hillock. In the early 1970s, hippies on their way to Ceylon turned this quiet fishing village into a famous holiday spot.
draft.hungryLine: In the evening the restaurants along the beach lay out the day's catch, so pick your fish and settle in, because nobody here rushes.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Climb the Vizhinjam Lighthouse above the beach, stroll to Hawa Beach in under five minutes, then walk about 18 min to Halcyon Castle.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Hop on a traditional catamaran for a sunset cruise. The local fishermen row them with bamboo paddles.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The sand here is partly black, thanks to the minerals ilmenite and monazite in it.

legends.title: India's first topless beach
legends.body: Hawa Beach got its name from the topless European women who used to crowd it. It was the first topless beach in India, though that's banned now.

legends.title: The fruit ladies never forget
legends.body: The fruit ladies on the beach make a great fruit salad for next to nothing. But they'll remember you, and if you buy from someone else next time, they'll take it very personally.

tips.title: Wear something on your feet.
tips.body: The dark sand heats up fiercely in the sun.

tips.title: Swim where the lifeguards are.
tips.body: Lighthouse and Hawa beaches have lifeguards, and strong currents can pull you out, so follow their instructions.

story.title: Halcyon Castle
story.body: The consort of Maharani Sethu Lakshmi Bayi of Travancore built Halcyon Castle here as a family retreat. That's when Kovalam first got noticed.

story.title: European guests
story.body: Foreign guests of the Travancore kingdom spotted Kovalam's potential as a beach destination. Kovalam means 'coconut grove', after all the palms.

story.title: Palace to hotel
story.body: The castle was sold to the Government of India and became a luxury hotel. Today it runs as a five-star hotel after a careful restoration.

story.title: The hippie trail
story.body: Hippies passing through on their way to Ceylon found these beaches. The fishing village became a major tourist destination.

story.title: A deep-water port
story.body: Next door in Vizhinjam, India's first deep water transshipment terminal was inaugurated on 2 May 2025.
